title: Curl will not accept vulnerability reports during July 2026
summary: Daniel Stenberg, the maintainer of curl, announces a temporary halt to vulnerability report submissions during July 2026 as part of a 'Summer of Bliss' initiative to address maintainer burnout in the popular open-source project.
problem_solved: Addresses maintainer burnout and sustainable open-source maintenance by creating designated rest periods for the curl project lead.
why_valuable: Highlights the human challenges in open-source maintenance and sets a precedent for healthy boundaries in critical infrastructure projects.
